csv_project_name: Consultant for Facility Condition Index Development
csv_scope_of_work: Island County is soliciting Statements of Qualifications from qualified consulting firms to provide professional services for a comprehensive countywide Facility Condition Assessment, Facility Condition Index development, deferred maintenance analysis, capital planning, asset management strategy, and strategic facilities planning effort. The County owns and operates a diverse portfolio of public facilities that support administration, justice, public safety, detention, health, human services, public works, maintenance, emergency management, and community service functions.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Planning/Master Planning, Electrical Engineering
csv_comments: ' *** Time Sensitive *** - Project Number: FAC26-21- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 06/19/2026 05:00 PM PDT
title: Consultant for Facility Condition Index Development
short_description: Countywide facility condition assessment, asset strategy, and capital planning for public buildings.
project_scope: Countywide assessment of Island County's public facility portfolio, including facility condition assessments, development of a Facility Condition Index, deferred maintenance analysis, capital planning, asset management strategy, and strategic facilities planning for administration, justice, public safety, detention, health, human services, public works, maintenance, emergency management, and community service facilities.
services: Professional consulting services for architecture, civil engineering, construction/project management, cost estimating, planning/master planning, and electrical engineering related to facility condition assessment and strategic facilities planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a facility assessment, asset management, and strategic planning assignment rather than structural design.
- Covers general public buildings without indication of architecturally demanding, large-span, or innovative structures.
- Includes project management, planning, and condition index development, which are not core target services for sbp.
- No specific bridge, roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building design component is described.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice. The scope concerns assessments, deferred maintenance analysis, and capital planning across a countywide building portfolio, but no facility sizes, number of buildings, or planned capital works values are provided.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the notice. This is a professional services procurement for assessments and planning, but the documents provided here do not include an estimated consultant budget or fee range.
references_qualifications: Qualified consulting firms are requested to provide professional services for countywide facility condition assessment, Facility Condition Index development, deferred maintenance analysis, capital planning, asset management strategy, and strategic facilities planning. No specific minimum number or type of reference projects is stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: Island County, Coupeville, Washington, USA. Contact: Mark Sibon. Phone: 360-678-7871. Fax: 360-678-4550. Email: m.sibon@islandcountywa.gov. Website: https://www.questcdn.com/cdn/posting/10239232/?path=269&search_id=
notes: Project number FAC26-21. Questions deadline: 06/19/2026 05:00 PM PDT. Solicitation documents available online. Although civil engineering is listed among requested disciplines, the notice is focused on facility condition assessment and strategic planning rather than building or structural design.
